changes.before: The Restorative Justice Hub at the University of California, Berkeley is the subject of this local prototype. Explore the educational materials, see how the archive will be organized, and help shape what the site should make easier to find.
changes.after: The Restorative Justice Hub at the University of California, Berkeley is a place to learn how communities respond to harm, build relationships, and pursue accountability and repair.

changes.before: This prototype makes space for learning about restorative justice, sharing projects and resources, and bringing people into conversation. The Hub’s official mission and current campus relationships are awaiting editorial review.
changes.after: Restorative practices make room for people to describe how they were affected, listen to one another, and decide how they want to participate. Explore the Hub’s learning guides and project materials to see how those ideas inform restorative practice.

changes.before: The former Berkeley Restorative Justice Center has a place in the historical archive. See Offerings for the status of current activities.
changes.after: The former Berkeley Restorative Justice Center is part of the history of restorative justice at Berkeley. The historical archive covers the Center’s earlier work. Find information on current activities under Offerings.

changes.before: This introduction was written for the prototype. It is available for editorial review.
changes.after: Restorative practices can help people build relationships before conflict arises or respond after harm has occurred. The people affected should have a say in whether the process goes ahead, what they are willing to share, and what support they need.

changes.before: Explore reading and discussion materials for learning about restorative justice. Starter resources are labeled for prototype review.
changes.after: Find guides for learning about restorative justice, reflecting on harm, and planning discussions that people can take part in. Search by keyword or browse by category.

changes.before: Read stories, reflections, and news from the Hub as they become available. The editorial team can review dates, bylines, and publication status before adding articles from the previous site.
changes.after: Browse news, reflections, and writing on restorative justice, community accountability, and repair.

changes.before: Explore restorative justice research, teaching, and community work as project records are added. Each record can carry its own credits, citations, links, and documents.
changes.after: Explore research, teaching, and community work on restorative justice, truth, and reconciliation. Project records identify contributors and link to sources for further study.

changes.before: This research space is for documented histories of violence against Indigenous peoples in California. Verified records will connect places to nation-specific context, date or date range, and sources for further reading.
changes.after: This collection focuses on documented sites of historical violence against Indigenous peoples in California. Records bring together place, date, the Nation or community affected, and sources for further reading.
